title: Combobox/useComboboxFloat: avoid autoUpdate loops when popover is CSS-hidden
answers: Why does the Combobox input re-render/update the DOM continuously when inside a collapsed details or hidden container?
Combobox causes excessive rerenders in Feature Control UI
How should floating-ui's autoUpdate be wired up for popovers that can be hidden via CSS?
useFloating whileElementsMounted keeps firing even when the combobox is closed/hidden
body: Symptom: Combobox rendered inside a collapsed <details> (or anything hidden with CSS rather than unmounted) kept re-rendering its input on every tick, causing constant DOM updates. Root cause: useComboboxFloat passed `whileElementsMounted: autoUpdate` to useFloating, so autoUpdate ran continuously even while the floating element was closed/hidden by CSS, not conditionally unmounted. Fix pattern: don't use `whileElementsMounted`; instead call `autoUpdate(referenceEl, floatingEl, update)` manually inside a `useEffect` gated on `isOpen` (and refs being set), returning its cleanup, so autoUpdate only runs while the popover is actually open. Constraints: this pattern applies to any floating-ui consumer whose trigger/content can be hidden via CSS while still mounted (collapsed details, display:none tabs, etc.) per floating-ui's own docs that autoUpdate is unsuitable for CSS-hidden elements; it's unnecessary for UI that is truly conditionally mounted/unmounted.
applies: floating-ui (@floating-ui/react) usage in grafana-ui components whose popover can be CSS-hidden while mounted
